message.content: One of the most iconic sculptures of the 19th century is **“The Thinker”** by Auguste Rodin (originally part of his larger work *The Gates of Hell*, 1880‑1902). Although it was cast in its now‑famous bronze form in the early 20th century, the original marble version dates back to 1880–1902 and became emblematic of modern sculpture. Other major 19th‑century works include Rodin’s *The Kiss* (1889), Jean‑Baptiste Coulon’s *La Marseillaise* (1871), and the monumental *Statue of Liberty* (1886).
